tasks.label: docker: up backend stack
tasks.command: docker compose up -d db cache backend gateway

tasks.label: generate mermaid diagrams
tasks.command: mkdir -p resources/images && for f in resources/mermaid/*.mmd; do [ -f "$f" ] && mmdc -i "$f" -o "resources/images/$(basename ${f%.mmd}.png)" -w 1050 --backgroundColor transparent -c resources/mermaid/mermaid-config.json; done
